title: Data-adaptive Safety Rules for Training Reward Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any faith/religion-specific aspects. Its focus is on general safety, evaluated through benchmarks like RewardBench-Safety and SafetyBench, which cover categories like ethics, morality, offensiveness, and bias without specifying religious contexts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
